objective: Return a compact production design for a Cloud Run continuity relay behind a website control UI. Website is UI only. Relay handles heartbeat, authenticated wake, idempotent job pickup and typed receipts; durable state stays external.
acceptance_criteria: ROOT_CAUSE: one sentence under 180 chars explaining why UI/storage are not daemons.
WORKFLOW: exactly five numbered one-line steps; total under 900 chars; cover health, wake, idempotency, execute, verify receipt.
RISK: one sentence under 220 chars naming duplicate execution, stale receipt, unauthenticated wake, cold-state loss and false completion.
falsifier: Reject if it treats website/file storage as a daemon, uses memory as durable truth, omits idempotency or receipt verification, or claims autonomous execution without an attributable request/scheduled wake.
